title: Barakah Island: our own practice map
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y5 lessons 6, 8, 9 (Barakah Island grid map: our own practice map (portal printable; the Cornerstones Alchemy Island map is used once checked in Maestro))
intro: Lessons 6, 8 and 9. Read along (eastings) first, then up (northings). Scale: each square is 1 km across.

blocks.caption: North is at the top. A made-up island for practice.

questions.q: Give the grid reference of the farm.
In which direction are the cliffs from the village?
Give the four-figure grid references for the beach, forest, river and tor.
Which feature is south-east of the village?
Write directions from the harbour to the tor using compass points and grid references.
questions.a: For example: from the harbour in 0402 go west to the farm in 0202, then north past the village in 0203 to the tor in 0204.
